x.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `bfloat16`, `half`, `float32`, `float64`, `complex64`, `complex128`.
constraints: x must be one of bfloat16, half, float32, float64, complex64, complex128
If x is not within the specified range, the result will be nan.

output.description: A `Tensor`. Has the same type as `x`.

constraints: The output shape is the same as the input shape.
